asset_heavy.reason: Custom switchgear manufacturing in a few factories and service centers; moderate capital needs, not utility-like heavy assets.

big_ticket.reason: Custom-engineered power control rooms and switchgear projects are large, infrequent capital purchases for buyers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial customers can delay capital projects like switchgear and power control rooms in oil, gas and petrochemical downturns.

large_customers.reason: Customers are oil and gas, petrochemical, utility and industrial majors buying large custom power distribution systems.

notes: Service and parts are a smaller part than the project-based manufacturing business.

offers_products.reason: Manufactures switchgear, PowlVac circuit breakers, bus duct and power control rooms.

offers_services.reason: Offers maintenance, field service, commissioning, retrofit and training, alongside the manufacturing business.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue mainly comes from manufactured electrical equipment; services are secondary.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from one-off custom engineered equipment projects; service and spare parts are smaller.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells electrical power distribution equipment to industrial and utility customers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to industrial, oil and gas, utility and renewables companies.
